name: Newberry
gaps: Source query returned 6794 rows; 6717 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are SC RFA Statewide_Parcels filtered to Newberry County (https://services9.arcgis.com/RvqSyw3diI7dTKo5/arcgis/rest/services/Lexington_Richland_Web_Map_WFL1/FeatureServer/18). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
tax partial: Current-ish market + land value on RFA/18 (~2026-01 load). Assessed/taxable only on City of Newberry-hosted layer whose CAMA attributes are a 2019 snapshot (max TransferDa 2019-05-29).
sale partial: Only public sale fields are on the city-hosted layer, frozen at 2019-05-29 — any sale after that is missing. Current sales via qPublic report.
owner partial: Owner name current on RFA/18; mailing address public only on 2019 city snapshot (stale).
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
